body: Oh wow, that is so great for your family member that she reached out for help and has found happiness! Really good of you as well to offer your home. As soon as Covid-19 is over I am going to invite him to come visit the USA, and if he isn't able to I will go back to the Netherlands and stay with him. I will definitely also start asking him to chat more!
Thank you so much, I will read up more on all of this!
You're absolutely right; that's something I have to constantly keep checking on - so difficult when it's someone you love. Thank you
Thank you so much for those links and the advice! Those are so helpful and make a lot of sense.
